5.10
Implementation Summary
The first phase of implementation establishes the application’s core infrastructure, includ-
ing authentication, database connectivity, workspace management, frontend development,
and REST API integration. These modules provide the foundation for the advanced AI
functionalities implemented in the subsequent sections.
5.11
Document Processing Module
The document processing module is responsible for extracting textual information from
uploaded documents before they are indexed for semantic search. The system supports
PDF, DOCX, and TXT file formats.
The implementation uses the PyMuPDF library for PDF processing and the python-
docx library for Microsoft Word documents. During processing, metadata such as docu-
ment title, author, keywords, page count, and file size are extracted and stored for future
reference.
The complete processing workflow consists of the following stages:
1. File Upload
2. File Validation
3. Text Extraction
4. Metadata Extraction
5. Structured JSON Storage
6. Chunk Generation
The extracted text is stored page-wise, allowing the citation engine to reference the
original page number while answering user queries.
